property_summary: After any sequence of newGrantProposal calls, the proposalCount getter equals the highest proposal ID for which a grant was actually stored in mapPID_grant; in the buggy mutant, calling newGrantProposal once stores the grant at an ID exceeding proposalCount, so proposalCount does not correspond to the ID of the stored grant.
change_summary: Replace mapPID_grant[proposalCount] = grant with mapPID_grant[proposalCount + 1] = grant, storing the grant details under a different ID than the emitted proposalCount.
